_about: Captured on the TinyCloud One build at 390641ab (web-sdk 3.14.0-beta.20) by the flows in sessionGrants.sdk.test.tsx, run in a capture mode that records what each flow asks the wallet to sign and the decoded ReCap the resulting session holds, with the anvil #1 test key at https://tinycloud.chat. The Connectors flows only: the sign-in asks for the three exact connector keys and nothing on the whole encryption network, without the Health Log and Recipes sample databases (TC-4244). session-grants.b7ecb653.json stays as the capture that lists those two databases. Details: TC-4112
